_doc: Penny weekly no-AI scan: generic defaults (ships with the template). install.sh copies this to thresholds.json if missing; tune thresholds.json after 2-3 weekly runs. Relative paths are relative to the Penny folder. Owner-specific data goes in local/owner.json, never here.

paths._cli_repo_roots_doc: CLI session cwd -> repo = first folder under the longest matching root (else the folder name). Generic roots only: '~' expands to the box user's home. Add owner-specific roots in local/owner.json cli_repo_roots. Tip: run CLI jobs from the project folder (not the bare root), so each repo maps cleanly to one bot.

wake._always_weekly_cost_doc: If true, quiet weeks still POST mode=cost_only so the bot sends a one-line weekly cost note (costs one short wake).

estimates._doc: est_runs_wk_saved is in run-equivalents/week. A gated quiet run costs (1 - gate_saving_fraction) of a full run. A subagent spawn counts as subagent_run_equiv runs.
estimates._bot_usd_doc: Converts bot-work estimates (replay-token proxy + est. calls x est_output_tokens_per_call) to ~$. If both input and output prices are set they are used; otherwise the blended price. Default blended $0.29/M = total $ / total tokens of the exact Grok Build CLI data on Oct 2, 2026 (208.6M tokens, $60.87, ~94% cached input). Replay proxy ignores cache discounts, so this is a rough order of magnitude.

A18._doc: Retime to reading: median delay from a surfaced run to the owner's next human message in that bot (delays over max_delay_h are unread, not slow reads).

A19._doc: Heavy model/effort on small CLI sessions. heavy_models: list of model ids treated as heavy (empty = effort only). Saved = sessions/wk x effort_saving_fraction (session-equivalents).

A20._doc: Chat bloat: long main chat still getting turns/wakes. Turns/wk = turns in the 7 days ending at the bot's newest local chat data. Saved = turns/wk x turn_saving_fraction (run-equivalents); signal shows the size-based replay proxy tokens and ~$ per week.
A20.fix: Consolidate learnings into memory/skills/a file first, then reset the chat. $ is an upper-bound estimate (old history gets summarized).

A21._doc: Always-on load: owner-written text a bot carries on every turn = instructions (profile.json description, live) + memory (the rendered memory section from the store.db prompt snapshot, else memory/profile.md files). Tokens = chars / chars_per_token. Flag when that owner load > max_always_on_tokens, or a routine prompt > max_routine_prompt_tokens fires >= min_fires_per_week. The app's own sections (platform_sections: bot directory, routine/connector guidance) are shown in the report for context but never flagged while count_platform_sections is false: they grow with fleet size and owners can't trim them. Weekly re-send ~$ = load x model calls/wk (turns x calls/turn) + routine prompt tokens x fires x calls/run, at estimates.bot_usd_per_m_tokens: an upper-bound estimate (prompt caching may discount repeats). Saved = (turns + fires)/wk x the share of the owner load above the threshold (run-equivalents).
A21.fix: move how-to detail into skills, keep profile memory small and push history to the log, prune stale facts, and keep routine prompts short by pointing to files

idle_bots._doc: A14 idle-bot tracking: idle = past min_days_unused on BOTH days since owner last viewed AND days since last human message. warn_days = early-warning list. Re-raise an already-raised idle bot only when its idle days grow by reraise_factor. Local signals only: confirm live before retiring a bot. Guardrail: a bot is listed idle only if its local store is fresh (require_fresh_store, newest entry within freshness.stale_days), at least min_signals local signals agree (view stamp and last human message both past min_days_unused), and no CLI session mapped to it within warn_days. Stale stores go to idle_unconfirmed (names only, no day counts); unread senders from stale stores are counted, not listed. wording_rule is copied into latest.json for the wake.
idle_bots.wording_rule: Local view/message stamps can lag live use by weeks. Only bots in idle_bots may be called idle, and only as 'local data shows no owner activity since <date> (unconfirmed; check with the bot)'. Never state days unviewed as fact. idle_unconfirmed = stale local data, not judged: mention at most as a count. Recent coding counts as use.

unread_sender._doc: Bot keeps posting to the owner while its chat goes unopened. Flag when >= min_unseen_msgs bot->user messages were sent after lastViewedAt AND lastViewedAt is >= min_days_unviewed old. Fresh = newest unseen message within freshness.stale_days; only fresh, not-yet-raised (or unseen_msgs doubled) senders make the wake mode 'report'.

daily_usage._doc: Per-day table. week: 'last_full' (most recent complete Mon-Sun; right for the Monday cron) or 'current' (this partial week). CLI cells are exact; est cells are estimates (#5 replay proxy, #16 turns/day x calls/turn). Main-chat replay per call is capped at context_cap_tokens.
daily_usage._table_layout_doc: split_spend (default): per-bot Coding $ (exact) | Bot work ~$ (estimate) | Total (coding only when bot coverage is below min_bot_coverage), overall line, then 'Coding by day (exact)'. by_day: older layout, CLI by day + estimate (calls · tokens) by day.
daily_usage._min_bot_coverage_doc: hide bot-work $ (show exact coding only) when fewer than this share of bots have local activity data newer than freshness.stale_days

trend._doc: Week-over-week trend in the Monday report. months -> N full Mon-Sun weeks = ceil(months x weeks_per_month). Coding $ is exact (Grok Build CLI per-turn data, backfilled as far as it exists); bot work ~$ is an estimate from local data and persisted rows in history/weekly_totals.json; missing = n/a, never 0.
trend._comparable_doc: Change vs prior week uses full totals only if both weeks' bot-day coverage is within this ratio; per-bot movers use bot work only when the bot was fully covered both weeks. Otherwise coding only.

budget._doc: Monthly line + early warning. Owner amounts live in local/owner.json (budget.monthly_usd, credit_balance_usd, balance_as_of). Rate = trailing rate_days average. warn when runway < warn_days or projected month-end > monthly budget; warn makes the wake a report.

new_bot_check._doc: Daily no-AI template-install check (new_bot_check.py). Flags scheduled AI routines on new bots (or new routines on bots first seen within watch_days) that are denser than hourly or poll on a schedule without a quiet rule. Webhook/event triggers are good. POSTs only when something is flagged.
new_bot_check.cron_comment: # Penny daily spike + new-bot check (no AI)
new_bot_check.quiet_regex: (?i)(stay quiet|stay silent|no filler|quiet if|silent if|nothing new)

alert_levels._doc: First-run choice stored in local/owner.json alert_level: quiet | normal | chatty (default normal). normal = this file as is (no overrides). quiet/chatty override the dotted keys below: report size (output.top_n, output.stale_watch_n; latest.json stays under output.summary_max_bytes either way), repeat threshold (wake.worse_factor: re-raise only when this much worse), the quiet-week cost note (wake.always_weekly_cost) and the spike-guard jump factor.

spike_guard._doc: Fleet-wide daily spike guard, run by new_bot_check.py (no AI). Per enabled routine, from local routine-run transcripts: runs and est. $ in the last 24h vs the trailing daily average over baseline_days (needs >= min_baseline_days of history before the window). Spike = >= factor x baseline AND above the floors (min_runs_per_day + min_extra_runs, or min_usd_per_day). Loop = >= loop_min_runs runs inside loop_window_min that also exceed loop_schedule_factor x what the cron allows (event routines: loop_min_runs alone), or fail_repeat identical consecutive failures in runs.json. Stale data never alerts: the newest routine-run transcript must be within max_data_age_hours. Each routine+kind wakes at most once per cooldown_days. Wakes mode=spike.

quick_audit._doc: First-chat quick audit (quick_audit.py, no AI): one cheap local pass over routines, chats and always-on text; names the top_n burners with a one-line why. Output summary/quick_audit.json (<= max_bytes) + summary/quick_audit.md. Local data can lag live state: every item says confirm live. max_chat_items: long-chat items allowed in the top list (their $ is an upper-bound proxy).

calibration._doc: Usage-page calibration (calibrate.py, no AI). Observations go to the owner-local file. bot_factor per window = (observed $ used - exact coding $) / Penny's bot-work estimate, only when bot data covers the window. summarize.py multiplies bot-work ~$ by the rolling median of the last rolling_n factors (clamped) and labels it 'calibrated' once >= min_observations exist; with fewer, output is unchanged. period_days_default: plan period length when only the reset date is known.

unmapped_cli._doc: Unmapped coding. Normal flow: a coding bot claims its own named project folder by messaging Penny DOGE once ('map <repo> -> me'); Penny runs claim_repo.py, which writes local/owner.json cli_repo_bots (bare roots refused; a repo already mapped to another bot is never overwritten and goes to cli_repo_conflicts). The owner is asked ONLY when report-week unmapped coding that is still unclaimed after claim_grace_days is large (>= min_usd, or >= min_share of coding and >= min_usd_floor), or when there is a claim conflict. Then latest.json gets unmapped_ask (top max_listed repos, a why line, one question). A repo is asked about once per ledger entry and re-asked only when its tokens grow by reraise_factor. Penny never auto-maps from guesses.
